groups.title: Browser extensions
groups.lede: Side panels and one-click helpers for browser chores.

projects.name: Config Copilot
projects.desc: Fill web console forms from one config JSON, value by value or in one learned click.

projects.name: Tab Export
projects.desc: One click saves every open tab in the window as a .webloc or .url shortcut file.

groups.title: Mac, Android & MCP
groups.lede: Small native utilities and MCP servers that put the right data next to Claude.

projects.name: Claude Meter
projects.desc: Claude plan usage in the Mac menu bar: session, weekly and model limits at a glance.

parts.name: aimeter
parts.kind: Download page on a Cloudflare Worker

projects.name: Shotlink
projects.desc: Phone screenshots reach the Mac in seconds, encrypted, ready for Claude over MCP.

projects.name: Outlook MCP
projects.desc: A local MCP server that lets Claude Code search, read and draft Outlook.com mail.

groups.title: The network's own plumbing
groups.lede: Shared pieces every *.sankhacooray.com site loads, so a fix in one place reaches them all.

projects.name: Shared components
projects.desc: Drop-in front-end modules every sub-site loads: the auto-theming footer, the analytics loader and chat.

parts.name: Components
parts.kind: Footer, analytics, chat and weather scripts

parts.name: Site assistant
parts.kind: Cloudflare Worker behind the chat widget

projects.name: Link previews
projects.desc: Every sub-site as the share card you see when its link is pasted into WhatsApp, iMessage or Slack.

projects.name: Visitor badge
projects.desc: One GA4 property for the whole network; each page shows its own visitors and its rank among siblings.

parts.name: Analytics proxy
parts.kind: Apps Script over the GA4 Data API

groups.title: Activity
groups.lede: A live view of what I'm building, drawn from the GitHub API and refreshed every hour.

projects.name: The lab
projects.desc: Every live sub-site as a tile, with a pulse on the ones pushed to in the last seven days.

parts.name: GitHub proxy
parts.kind: Apps Script, caches GraphQL for 1 h

projects.name: Code cosmos
projects.desc: Each repository as a star in a 360° sky: brighter for recent work, bigger for more activity.

projects.name: One year, day by day
projects.desc: A 365-day contribution canvas and the latest commits across every repository, freshest first.

excluded: Left out on purpose: Concur Copilot (expense claims), OTP Courier (bank OTPs from a personal mailbox), Nest Skim (home camera), Lookout and the auth gate (personal accounts, admin console), Doctor Lanka (medical), ytvault (private playlists, local only), shake-fixer (AHLab concept deck).
thumbsNote: No Worker here (GitHub Pages), so thumbnails are files in thumbs/: live og:images for Claude Meter, Shotlink, cdn and meta; a store screenshot for Export Tabs; designed cards from thumbs-src/ for Config Copilot, Outlook MCP and the visitor badge; screenshots of /activity/ for the activity cards.
cardsNote: Cards show only things people use. Backends and helper repos are listed as parts of their product (hover the parts chip).
